visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a black Adidas-style jacket and a black pleated skirt, stands in front of a light blue wall adorned with large pink polka dots. She holds a massive, fluffy pink cotton candy that is nearly half the size of her body. (2) A man with a short haircut and a blue baseball cap appears in a close-up selfie shot, sticking out his pink-stained tongue and laughing. The setting shifts to a brightly lit, modern indoor shopping mall with polished floors and colorful signage. (3) The woman walks through the mall, excitedly showing her own pink-stained tongue to the camera. She stops in front of a shop called 'DECORA CREAMERY' and looks at a digital menu showing giant, multi-colored cotton candies in shapes of umbrellas and hearts. (4) Behind a glass partition, staff members in white shirts, striped aprons, and face masks are seen operating cotton candy machines, spinning large quantities of pink, yellow, and purple sugar onto sticks. (5) The woman stands at a 'PICK UP' window and receives a giant pink cotton candy. She poses for several photos against the polka-dot wall, laughing and comparing the size of the candy to her head. (6) She attempts to eat the cotton candy, which is extremely airy and sticky, causing it to press against her face and nose. She continues to eat it while walking and sitting in the mall, looking amused and slightly overwhelmed by its size.
